name: @edx/brand
description: EduLage design system for Open edX. Drop-in replacement for @edx/brand (Paragon brand override built from edulage.org tokens, fonts, logos and MFE chrome styles).

scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/core.scss dist/core.min.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed scss/light.scss dist/light-override.min.css
scripts.build:assets: cp -r fonts images dist/ && cp images/favicon.ico dist/favicon.ico && cp images/edulage-logo.png dist/logo.png && cp images/edulage-logo-white.png dist/logo-white.png && cp images/edulage-logo.png dist/logo-trademark.png && cp svg/logo.svg svg/logo-white.svg svg/logo-trademark.svg dist/ && cp theme-urls.json dist/
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npm run build:css && npm run build:light && npm run build:assets
